title: LaMe: a Joint Latent Mediation Framework for High-Dimensional Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.18180v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mediation analysis seeks to understand how an exposure influences an outcome through intermediate variables. However, as increasingly rich datasets become available, hundreds to thousands of potential mediators make these systems difficult to model and hard to interpret. Latent-variable approaches offer a natural way to accommodate these high-dimensional settings. However, existing latent mediation methods face limitations, including overparameterization, biased inference, or limited scalability. We develop LaMe, a joint linear-Gaussian framework that summarizes a high-dimensional exposure-mediator-outcome system through a small number of latent variables. We identify natural direct and indirect effects under an explicit assumption that the manifest measurements fully capture the latent mediators, and characterize conditions under which the latent representation effectively restricts the observed cross-covariance structure. Simulations

translated_title: LaMe：面向高维系统的联合潜在中介分析框架
translated_abstract: 中介分析旨在理解暴露因素如何通过中间变量影响结果。然而，随着日益丰富的数据集的出现，成百上千个潜在中介变量使得这些系统难以建模和解释。潜变量方法为处理这类高维场景提供了一种自然的途径。然而，现有的潜在中介方法存在诸多局限，包括过度参数化、推断有偏或可扩展性受限。我们开发了LaMe，这是一个联合的线性-高斯框架，通过少量潜变量来概括高维的暴露-中介-结果系统。我们在一个明确的假设下（即显性测量完全捕捉潜中介变量）识别出自然直接效应和间接效应，并刻画了潜在表示能够有效约束观测交叉协方差结构的条件。模拟实验...
tldr: 该论文提出LaMe，一个联合线性-高斯潜在中介框架，通过少量潜变量概括高维的暴露-中介-结果系统，在明确假设下识别自然直接与间接效应，克服了现有方法过度参数化、推断有偏和可扩展性受限的问题。
en_tdlr: LaMe is a joint linear-Gaussian latent mediation framework that summarizes high-dimensional exposure-mediator-outcome systems through a small number of latent variables, identifying natural direct and indirect effects while overcoming overparameterization, biased inference, and limited scalability of existing methods.
